恢复点已经保存。已跟踪文件会还原到 Index 版本，untracked 文件会: Recovery points are saved. Tracked files will return to their Index version and untracked files will be removed from the Worktree. Both can be undone from Recovery.
Discard 仅支持 32 MiB 以内、没有硬链接的普通文件。: Discard supports regular files up to 32 MiB without hard links.
点击后由 Agent 只读访问完整项目目录，使用其现有登录和额度。AI 结果不会: The Agent can read the complete project directory using its existing login and quota. AI results never mark changes as Reviewed.
Hook 只记录已授权的 Worktree。安装前预览修改，安装后检查连接；不会: Hooks only record authorized Worktrees. Preview changes before installation and verify the connection afterwards; no model is called.
Claude Code Hook 暂未开放安装。: Claude Code Hook installation is not available yet.
此平台暂不支持安装 Agent Hook。: Agent Hook installation is not supported on this platform yet.
Proof 的 Codewiz 插件文件已存在或被修改，请先核对文件。: The Proof Codewiz plugin file already exists or was modified. Check the file first.
变更清单超过本机资源上限，请缩小范围。: The change list exceeds local resource limits. Select a smaller scope.
项目目录不能位于可写运行目录内。: The project directory cannot be inside the writable Agent runtime.
配置目录不存在。: The configuration directory does not exist.
分析范围目录无法安全授权。: The analysis evidence directory cannot be granted safely.
Proof Hook 已安装。下次启动 Codewiz 时加载插件；正在运行的: Proof Hook installed. The plugin loads the next time Codewiz starts; running Sessions are unchanged.
通过本地插件记录任务、文件操作和回复。安装后，重新打开 Codewiz 即可生效: A local plugin records tasks, file operations and replies. Reopen Codewiz after installation to load it.
例如：按业务行为分组，将实现与测试放在同一组，组名保持简短。: For example: group by behavior, keep implementations and tests together, and use short titles.
例如：重点检查并发、错误处理和兼容性，指出缺少的边界测试。: For example: focus on concurrency, error handling and compatibility, and identify missing edge-case tests.
例如：使用 Conventional Commits，标题用英文，正文用中文说明: For example: use Conventional Commits, an English subject and a Chinese body explaining why.
留空使用默认规则。自定义 Prompt 应用于所有 Agent，保存后在下次手动: Leave blank to use defaults. These prompts apply to every Agent and take effect on your next manual run.
自定义 Prompt 过长或包含无效字符。: The custom prompt is too long or contains invalid characters.
请先 Stage 要提交的变更。: Stage the changes you want to commit first.
根据 Staged 变更生成，不会执行 Commit。: Generate from staged changes. No commit is performed.
根据上一条 Commit 和 Staged 变更生成。: Generate from the last commit and staged changes.
变更已更新，请重新生成提交说明。: Changes have been updated. Generate the message again.
生成期间已编辑说明，AI 建议保留在下方。: Your message changed during generation. The AI suggestion is shown below.
通过本机 Coding Agent 执行 Grouping、Review 和 A: Run Grouping, Review and AI Commit with a local Coding Agent and its existing login.
在 CLI 中继续此会话: Continue this session in the CLI
Agent 会话未能保存，请查看失败详情。: The Agent session could not be saved. Check the failure details.
每次运行新建会话并保留到对应 Agent。已有终端会话不会被接续。: Each run creates and saves a new session in its Agent. Existing terminal sessions are never resumed.
会话由对应 Agent 管理，清除 Proof 本地数据不会删除这些会话。: Sessions are managed by their Agent. Clearing Proof data does not delete them.
用本地 Branch 的历史更新远程 Branch。仅当远程仍指向下方确认的 C: Update the remote Branch with this local Branch history. Proceed only if the remote still points to the confirmed Commit below; stop if it has changed.
HEAD 尚未加载时，显示当前分支历史。: Show current branch history if HEAD is not loaded.
